originalScenarioCompleteUnchanged.originalTextUnchanged: UN5-06-A: Six consenting creatures form the link,including its caster. A participant900feet away sends one25-word idea to two chosen members despite lacking a shared spoken language; it conveys the sender's intended ordinary meaning,not unseen room images or a new language proficiency. A third member receives nothing from that private subset.

If Prophecy is suppressed for ten seconds, missed arrivals are not replayed; on return it reports only still-live prospective effects before the original sixty-second deadline, without changing future choices.
